orgs.name: Alcoholics Anonymous - DuPage County (Northern Illinois Area 20, Districts 40/41/42/43)
services: DuPage County has no single A.A. intergroup - A.A. is organized here as four Northern Illinois Area 20 districts, each with its own meeting list and 24-hour hotline
District 41 (Elmhurst, Lombard, Villa Park, Addison, Bensenville, Oakbrook Terrace): hotline 630-833-7897, meeting list at dupage41aa.org (fetched live 2026-10-22)
District 40 (Glen Ellyn, Wheaton, West Chicago): hotline 630-653-6556
District 42 (Downers Grove, Hinsdale, Westmont): hotline 630-387-9942
District 43 (Naperville, Lisle, Bolingbrook): hotline 630-355-2622, meeting list at aa-nia-dist43.org
meeting schedules are maintained by the districts - use the district sites or the official Meeting Guide app; schedules are linked, never scraped
orgs.serves: anyone with a desire to stop drinking in DuPage County
